servicesIntro: Choose the service family closest to your requirement, then connect the scope with your users, systems and delivery responsibilities.

services.title: Cloud
services.body: Assess the current environment, plan workload changes and agree the cloud operating responsibilities.

services.title: Data & AI
services.body: Connect data sources, clarify reporting needs and evaluate a practical AI use case with appropriate review.

services.title: Custom Software
services.body: Define user workflows, develop applications and connect the systems those applications depend on.

services.title: Managed IT
services.body: Define the systems, user support, maintenance and escalation work within an agreed support scope.

staffing: Compare Staff Augmentation, Direct Hire and Dedicated Remote Teams for cloud, data, software and IT operations requirements. Start by defining the role, the work and who will manage delivery.

models.title: Staff Augmentation
models.body: Add a defined skill or capacity to an existing team. Agree the responsibilities, duration and day-to-day management before the engagement begins.
models.best_for: A team that needs additional specialist capacity for defined work.
models.scope_to_agree: Role, duration, supervision, working arrangement and commercial terms.

models.title: Direct Hire
models.body: Support a permanent recruitment requirement. Define the role and selection criteria, then agree the recruitment scope and employment arrangement with the hiring organization.
models.best_for: A permanent position with an approved hiring requirement.
models.scope_to_agree: Role, selection process, employer, location and recruitment terms.

models.title: Dedicated Remote Teams
models.body: Plan a focused remote team around an agreed body of work. Define the team structure, delivery ownership, collaboration hours and working arrangements together.
models.best_for: Work that needs a defined team structure rather than one additional role.
models.scope_to_agree: Team composition, management, delivery ownership, location eligibility and collaboration.
